Resolves #19094

After a staged shell swap, `Reconciler.reconcileProjection` forced every tab-overflow control visible and only then let each plugin recapture its natural widths — a rule from the floating-control era, where hiding was transport state. The dock's header rail runs the plugin in action mode, where the control is a toolbar contribution whose visibility is the plugin's own verdict, so the forced un-hide painted a control with nothing to show on a newborn single-tab strip until the recapture hid it again ~6 ms later: one frame, deterministic on the dense Workstation tour's `splitNode(security → below scale)` beat. The restore now applies only to floating-mode controls (six lines, `src/dashboard/dock/projection/Reconciler.mjs`); the newborn's own verdict was never wrong — its five projection passes all computed an empty hidden set, and the writer was named by a `hidden` observer with the call stack (`Reconciler.mjs:612` ← `reconcileProjection` ← `Workspace.refreshDockWorkspace`). Classification with the probe facts: #19094's body.

Evidence: L2 (headless e2e over the seat's own Neural Link bridge, `NEO_NL_PORT` per #19066) → L2 required (AC-2 is the dense witness's assertion). Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the pre-commit lint-staged hooks ran (secrets, whitespace, shorthand, jsdoc-types, ticket-archaeology, block-alignment, parse, class-module-scope, fixed-sleeps, engine-brain-boundary).

## Deltas from ticket
- The ticket suspected the plugin's own birth pass (a zero extent or a missing active id). Measured: the plugin's verdict was correct every time; the un-hide came from the dock reconciler's post-swap restore. The fix therefore lands in `src/dashboard/dock/projection/Reconciler.mjs`, not in `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs`.
- The in-place projection branch already trusted the plugin's verdict (it recaptures without un-hiding); the staged branch now matches it for action-mode controls.

## Test Evidence
- Red-first: with the fix stashed, the new unit arm reds (`the swap never forces the action-mode control visible` — a `false` transition received); with it, 109/109 across the reconciler and tab tiers and 1205/1205 in `unit/dashboard`.
- Dense witness at `62c9e0dd5c`: the whole tracked `WorkstationNL.spec.mjs`, three consecutive runs (`--repeat-each=3`), 27 of 27 — the dense tour reaches its monitor with the Canvas fix in and the duplicate-overflow frame count is 0 in each run; the sub-pixel compare at `:2546` (#19114, Euclid's PR #19116) did not fire in these three. Pre-fix control: the duplicate frame appears 4 of 4 in the same vehicle. History at `255b3af282`: every dense-tour run died at the Canvas receipt before the monitor (12 of 16 that morning), the other eight tests 8/8 in all three, and the assertion was taken on the softened copy described in AC-2.
- Not in CI: `WorkstationNL.spec.mjs` is a Neural Link spec (deselected by the e2e CI filter); the unit arm is CI-covered.
